content: Large win: QED 0.634 -> 0.878 and SA 3.80 -> 2.69 in one edit, MW 323. One thing left to clean up: the isopropoxyethyl tail on the sulfonyl (atoms 0-5) contributes 4 of the 6 rotatable bonds and is pure flexible ballast. Cutting the non-ring S-CH2 bond 6-5 and putting a methyl there gives the methanesulfonyl azetidine, which drops rotatable bonds to 1, lowers SA further, and leaves the indazole as the dominant feature of the molecule.
